title: Project X: Q3 Architecture & Milestone Roadmap
content: In Q3, Project X underwent a major architectural evolution. We successfully transitioned from a monolithic backend to a modular microservices architecture. Key milestones include launching the GraphQL gateway for consolidated data access, implementing WebSocket real-time updates for live dashboards, and decoupling the notification subsystem. Key decision: standardizing on Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet for natural language processing.

title: Project X: Executive Status Update (Q3)
content: Quarterly summary for Project X: The team achieved 80% of Q3 objectives. Highlights include: complete UI redesign with modern dark aesthetics, enterprise SSO refactoring, and database schema migration for scaling to 1M daily active users. Main bottleneck: third-party API rate limits and compliance sign-offs.

title: Project X: Launch Risk & Compliance Alignment Meeting (Sept 18, 2026)
content:
Meeting Notes - Launch Risk Review:
1. SOC2 Audit Logs: High risk item. Required audit logging for administrative mutations is currently behind schedule (JIRA-106). Target resolution date: Sept 28.
2. Payment API Rate Limits: Stripe sandbox API throttling during peak tests could delay dynamic billing launch. Mitigation: Implement local caching layer.
3. Failover Readiness: Database read replica failover tests passed, but automated failover alert latency is 45 seconds (target < 15s).

title: Project X: Memory & Context Strategy Sync
content:
Decisions on Agentic RAG architecture:
- Use SQLite for local MVP state persistence (sessions, QA history, extracted user/project facts).
- Vector storage (Chroma/Pinecone) will be added in Phase 2 for semantic retrieval.
- Context truncation strategy: Keep top 5 most relevant facts per session alongside retrieved live Jira/Notion items.

title: Project X: Security & Auth Module Specification
content:
Security Specification:
- All API endpoints require Bearer JWT token verification.
- OAuth2 PKCE flow for desktop and mobile clients.
- Token revocation list maintained in Redis cache.
- Sarah Chen leading auth migration work (JIRA-101).

title: Project X: Frontend Performance Review
content:
Frontend audit results:
- Page load time reduced from 3.2s to 0.9s after Vite migration and code splitting.
- Implemented virtualized list components for rendered Jira feed.
- Added real-time WebSocket connection status badge in header.

title: Project X: Third-Party Integrations Policy
content:
Standard operating procedure for third-party APIs:
- Exponential backoff required for 429 Rate Limit responses.
- Circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures if Notion/Jira endpoints timeout.
- Fallback to cached local mock data during vendor outages.

title: Project X: Incident Post-Mortem - Latency Spike in Search
content: On Sept 10, search latency spiked to 4.5 seconds. Root cause: Missing composite index on (project_id, updated_at) in read replica. Resolution: Added index and increased memory allocation. Follow-up ticket created: JIRA-102 assigned to Alex Rivera.

title: Project X: Launch Go/No-Go Checklist
content:
Launch Checklist Status (Target Launch: Oct 15):

title: Project X: Product Requirement Document (PRD) - Realtime Agentic RAG
content:
PRD Overview:
Build an intelligent Q&A assistant that queries live operational tools (Jira, Notion) and retains conversational memory. Must decompose queries into sub-questions, synthesize responses with exact inline citations [Jira #id] / [Notion pg. id], and render transparent reasoning traces.
